narrative: Micron's fiscal-Q3 print is the origin signal: all of 2026's HBM supply is sold out under multi-year contracts, the maker can fill only half to two-thirds of demand, and 16 take-or-pay agreements lock in roughly $100 billion. Supply this scarce forces buyers to disclose memory allocation as a named gating limit, the structural force this thesis tracks.
remaining_gap: No buyer-side accelerator vendor or hyperscaler has yet named HBM allocation as a gating cap on its own shipments.
